name: Durrani: Perjuangan Lion Mum
overview: After clinching a major win in a high stakes divorce case, ambitious lawyer and Lion Mum, Durrani (Nurul Aini) treads into the unpredictable world of family law. She soon learns that it's an entirely different battlefield - one where love, loss and conflict blur the lines between right and wrong, and every case tests not just her skill, but her heart.
